Team overview
Progressed model routing this week, Sensor early warning and speech recognition experiments. Friday review will verify evidence, Limitations & Next Steps.

Lin
Sensor drift early-warning: Completed patch-length Comparative Study. Next: verify lead time and false alarms on independent device data.

Next week: assemble evaluation set v2, And archive experiment findings for this round.
